title: Project Amigo — Initial Scope Planning & Assignment 01

tasks.title: Select 3 Initial Delivery Capabilities
tasks.instruction: Select the three modules that must be delivered first based on the client's mandatory appraisal deadline and day-to-day operations.

options.title: Leave Management
options.reason: Core HR baseline required alongside attendance

options.title: Payroll Integration
options.reason: High complexity financial dependency; defer to Phase 2

options.title: Recruitment ATS
options.reason: Non-critical path for the existing 80,000 workforce

tasks.title: LDAP Dependency Strategy
tasks.instruction: How should engineering proceed while waiting for the bank's security team to provision LDAP sandbox credentials?

options.label: Proceed on assumptions and defer SSO access setup to the end of development.
Record the LDAP sandbox credentials as an explicit dependency, proceed with modules that do not require SSO, and follow up immediately with the security team.
Pause all project work until the bank provisions the credentials.

tasks.title: Mandatory Validation Gates
tasks.instruction: Select all essential technical gates that must be satisfied before sprint kickoff.

options.label: Simulate and validate peak load capacity of 30,000 concurrent logins
Define core data flows and database schemas for prioritized modules
Complete all visual UI mockups for all 12 modules
Procure dedicated on-premise hardware before writing any code
